why: Wave 13s round 155, item 30c part 3: a kind column, person or agent, beside four columns that hold the id of whoever did a thing, so the identity census can tell a person's id from an agent's. Each is nullable, its writer fills it, and the data half of the migration tells the rows written before it where the registries say. A row it cannot tell keeps NULL and is counted as one that cannot be told.
